title: GRAFT-EEG: Gauge-Aware Physical Field Transport for Cross-Dataset Motor-Imagery EEG
abstract: arXiv:2610.23620v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Cross-dataset EEG decoding often treats montage, reference, and active-sensor changes as representation shift, although they also alter the observation operator. We study target-statistics-blind transfer: fitting receives no target signal, label, or empirical statistic, and electrode coordinates only instantiate a fixed prediction operator. method removes the active-set common-reference gauge and transports each native mask through a template motor leadfield. A source-fitted spectral classifier anchors the decision; a bounded state-space-model (SSM) residual is secondary. We establish restricted identifiability and an operator-perturbation bound. Across five leave-one-dataset-out targets (253 participants), dynamic method achieved 60.865% equal-target balanced accuracy versus 52.684% for strict-clean 5/5 BIOT (hierarchical difference +8.182 points; 95% CI +6.382 to +10.196; positive in every target). translated_title: GRAFT-EEG：面向跨数据集运动想象脑电的规范感知物理场传输
translated_abstract: 跨数据集脑电解码通常将导联布局、参考设置和有效电极的变化视为表征偏移，但实际上它们还会改变观测算子。我们研究目标统计盲迁移：拟合过程不接收任何目标信号、标签或经验统计量，电极坐标仅用于实例化一个固定的预测算子。该方法移除了有效电极集合的公共参考规范，并通过模板运动导联场传输每个原生电极掩码。源域拟合的谱分类器作为决策锚点，有界的状态空间模型（SSM）残差则作为辅助。我们建立了受限可辨识性结果和算子扰动界。在五个留一数据集目标（共253名被试）上，动态方法取得了60.865%的等目标平衡准确率，而严格干净设置下的5/5 BIOT为52.684%（层次差+8.182个百分点；95%置信区间+6.382至+10.196；在每个目标上均为正向）。在四个EEGPT-clean目标上，……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: GRAFT-EEG通过移除有效电极集合的公共参考规范并借助模板导联场传输电极掩码，实现了完全不依赖目标数据统计信息的跨数据集运动想象脑电解码，在253名被试上将平衡准确率从BIOT的52.684%提升至60.865%。
en_tdlr: GRAFT-EEG removes the active-set common-reference gauge and transports each electrode mask through a template motor leadfield, enabling target-statistics-blind cross-dataset motor-imagery EEG decoding that lifts balanced accuracy from 52.684% (BIOT) to 60.865% across 253 participants.
